title: BSc Paramedical Interns Launch Strike Across Jammu Kashmir, Demand Monthly Stipend

ai.summary: BSc Paramedical interns across Jammu and Kashmir have launched a strike demanding monthly stipends after a government proposal was processed years ago but no final decision was made.

facts.claim: BSc Paramedical interns at several Government Medical Colleges (GMCs) across Jammu and Kashmir have launched an agitation demanding monthly stipends
facts.quote: SRINAGAR: BSc Paramedical interns at several Government Medical Colleges (GMCs) across Jammu and Kashmir have launched an agitation demanding monthly stipends, with the interns abstaining from work over the non-implementation of a long-pending government proposal.

facts.claim: The agitation comes amid a separate strike by non-gazetted employees of five newly established Government Medical Colleges
facts.quote: The agitation comes amid a separate strike by non-gazetted employees of five newly established Government Medical Colleges, who have been protesting for the past 12 days.

facts.claim: The interns said a government proposal to grant monthly stipends to B.Sc Paramedical interns had been processed several years ago, but no final decision had been taken so far
facts.quote: The interns said a government proposal to grant monthly stipends to B.Sc Paramedical interns had been processed several years ago, but no final decision had been taken so far.

facts.claim: They have appealed to the Jammu and Kashmir Government to intervene, expedite the pending proposal and fulfil their demand for monthly stipends
facts.quote: They have appealed to the Jammu and Kashmir Government to intervene, expedite the pending proposal and fulfil their demand for monthly stipends.

facts.claim: The interns’ absence from work has raised concerns over the possible impact on hospital functioning and patient care
facts.quote: The interns’ absence from work has raised concerns over the possible impact on hospital functioning and patient care.
